tasks.short: Source suitable costumes or wardrobe items and submit a checked purchase or rental order.

steps.what: Clarify the costume requirements, measurements, timing and available budget
Retrieve available costume stock, rental options and supplier terms
Examine costume examples or wardrobe items for suitability, condition and fit
Choose whether to purchase or rent the suitable wardrobe items
Write the costume purchase or rental order and its delivery particulars
Submit the checked final wardrobe order to the selected supplier
Record the wardrobe commitment, supplier reference and expected delivery

tasks.design: Configure linked stock and sourcing references in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}, with a native order template in {PROCUREMENT}. Keep requirement clarification and item choice, separately write and submit the final order through {EMAIL}, then record the commitment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock facts and order particulars are repeatedly located and entered.
tasks.enabler_now: Native stock views and order headings can simplify supporting work.
tasks.still_hard: Fit, period suitability, item condition and delivery timing require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a costume that works for the performer and production.
tasks.altitude: Focus sourcing on suitability and dependable availability.

reach.learn: Distinguish tentative options from submitted commitments.

evidence.claim: Native stock views and order templates could reduce wardrobe sourcing administration; this is an E1 scenario.

assumptions: The scenario uses a supplier purchase or rental order. An internal requisition would use internal authority and its actual recipient rather than an external supplier send.

The attendant produces item identity, size, quantity, supplier, agreed price, rental dates and delivery particulars in s5, retaining 15 hours. Missing availability or terms require manual clarification before submission.
Native views and templates come first. No software selects wardrobe, commits money or sends an unchecked order, and no new budget approval procedure is invented.
The actual order submission checks its exact final version and supplier. Ordinary internal author saves have no self-approval stage or saving.
unknowns: Stock record completeness and supplier order format compatibility.
research_questions: Do native order headings save time when costume suppliers use bespoke rental terms?

already_counted.description: Capture and correct the wardrobe order particulars.

incremental.description: Maintain stock links and sourcing templates.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final order, items, sizes, quantities, prices, rental and delivery dates and supplier recipient; any change requires renewed submission-time checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 case: B=100, R=91, gross=9; upkeep=2 gives net=7. Conservative case: poor stock metadata leaves lookup and final record unchanged, while order headings retain 17 of 20 writing hours, R=97, net=1. Usable stock data with lookup 14, order writing 16 and record four gives R=94, net=4. Clarification, inspection, choice and actual submission retain 60 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study period clothing sources and record evidence-based style conclusions.

steps.what: Define the historical period, locale and clothing questions for the production
Locate books, pictures and period clothing examples relevant to the research scope
Study the books, pictures or examples and assess their historical context
Write period clothing notes with source pages, image references and observed features
Determine supported historical styles and record their relevance and uncertainty

tasks.design: Configure a period and locale reference collection and source-note headings in {DOCS}. Keep close study and historical interpretation with the attendant; simplify locating references and separately writing source-linked notes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant references and source note headings are repeatedly found and assembled.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference views and note templates can organise existing research material.
tasks.still_hard: An image may depict an exceptional, stylised or incorrectly dated garment.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret clothing in its historical and social context rather than treating an image as universal evidence.
tasks.altitude: Give research effort to historical context and defensible style choices.

reach.learn: Trace the proposed style to its source and limitations.

evidence.claim: Native indexed reference collections and source-note headings could reduce research support effort without replacing historical interpretation.

assumptions: This scenario includes existing research notes and written style conclusions. These writes are separately priced from studying sources rather than excluded from the task.

The attendant produces source identity, page or image reference, date context, locale, observed feature and limitation in s4, retaining 15 hours. Uncertain dating or provenance requires manual investigation and remains qualified.
Native reference tags and headings come first. No generated historical claim, invented source or image interpretation model is proposed.
Internal author edits and ordinary same-system saves have no approval stage or separate saving.
unknowns: Reference collection metadata and availability of reliably dated examples.
research_questions: Do native reference tags reduce lookup when source dating and locale are uncertain?

already_counted.description: Write source-linked research notes and limitations.

incremental.description: Maintain reference tags and note headings.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 case: B=100, R=91, gross=9; upkeep=2 gives net=7. Conservative case: unindexed books and uncertain provenance retain all 20 lookup hours and 17 of 20 note hours, R=97, net=1. Reliably tagged references with lookup 18 and notes 16 give R=94, net=4. Scope, close study and style interpretation retain 60 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review production scripts and record the setting, characters and justified costume requirements.

steps.what: Obtain the current scripts and relevant production information
Identify and record script revisions, scenes, cast identities and known character aliases
Review scripts for explicit locale, period, characters and costume references

loop.purpose: Extract explicit setting, character and costume references into a draft breakdown.
loop.input: Current script text, source revision and verified cast identities and aliases.
loop.output: Scene and character breakdown with source passages and uncertainty markers.
loop.check: Attendant checks each extracted reference against the script and cast list, including implicit changes the draft may miss.
loop.stop: One revision; ambiguous, missing or contradictory scenes are read and entered manually.
loop.why_not_simpler: A blank worksheet cannot extract varied script prose, while keyword matching misses contextual references.

steps.what: Determine the story's setting, character count and actual required costumes
Write the production costume requirements and open questions in the breakdown record
Check the costume breakdown for omitted characters, scenes and script revision mismatches

tasks.design: Use a native costume breakdown template in {DOCS}, with bounded extraction from the current script and verified cast context. The attendant checks explicit references, determines actual requirements and separately records and verifies the completed breakdown.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scripts must be repeatedly read and translated into scene and character costume records.
tasks.enabler_now: A fixed breakdown structure and source-linked extraction can assist the initial read-through.
tasks.still_hard: Costume needs can be implied by action or production choices rather than explicit dialogue.
tasks.human_edge: Determine what the production actually needs and recognise what the script leaves unresolved.

ambition.what: Spot missing costume requirements when script revisions arrive.

tasks.altitude: Move breakdown effort toward interpretation and omissions rather than first-pass extraction.

reach.task: Plan costumes from the production breakdown
reach.learn: Distinguish script evidence from unresolved production decisions.

evidence.claim: A bounded script extraction draft and native breakdown headings could reduce initial reading and recording; the task-specific saving is E1.

assumptions: The production team supplies the cast list as an existing source. The attendant captures and verifies script revision, scenes, cast names and known aliases in s2 with all 15 hours retained; missing or conflicting identities require manual clarification.
The loop extracts explicit references and cannot decide costume design, invent a historical setting or silently merge characters. Its 18 retained hours include source comparison and correction.
Native worksheet headings are tried first. Determination of actual costume needs and final omission checking remain human actions.
The breakdown write is part of the task and separately priced. No publication or send is proposed; ordinary author saves have no approval stage or separate saving.
unknowns: Script format consistency, revision frequency and cast alias quality.
research_questions: Does extraction save first-pass work after implied costume changes and missing characters are checked?

already_counted.description: Check and correct the script breakdown extraction.

incremental.description: Maintain extraction checks and production breakdown headings.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 case: B=100, R=85, gross=15; upkeep=4 gives net=11. Conservative case: inconsistent scene formatting and aliases retain 26 of 30 extraction hours and 14 of 15 record hours, R=95, net=1. Consistent scripts with extraction 22 and recording 13 give R=90, net=6. Source gathering, context capture, requirements judgement and final checking retain 55 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inventory costume stock, assess condition and separately update and reconcile the records.

steps.what: Retrieve the costume inventory list, item identities and storage locations
Locate the costume stock and match actual items to inventory identities
Inspect costume types, completeness and condition to determine usable availability
Record costume counts, item types, locations and actual condition findings
Reconcile the inventory against physical stock and correct unresolved item discrepancies

tasks.design: Configure a native stock view and costume condition entry layout in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the wardrobe inventory system. Keep locating, physical condition assessment and reconciliation; simplify the separately priced lookup and record update.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock locations and condition details require repeated navigation and entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native stock views and condition fields can support a consistent inventory record.
tasks.still_hard: Unlabelled items, missing pieces and actual wear require physical inspection.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish an item that exists from a costume that is complete and usable.
tasks.altitude: Make usable stock visible without replacing condition judgement.

reach.learn: Check completeness and condition rather than relying only on a stock count.

evidence.claim: Native wardrobe stock views and condition fields could reduce inventory support effort while retaining physical inspection.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM means the wardrobe inventory system. The inventory record is part of this task and separately priced from looking at and handling costumes.

The attendant produces item identity, type, count, location, completeness, condition and usable status in s4, retaining 14 hours. Missing identities or uncertain condition require manual reconciliation in s5.
Native stock views and field layouts come first. No automatic visual inspection, barcode rollout or hidden machine record update is assumed.
Ordinary internal author saves have no approval stage or separate saving. Physical item matching, condition assessment and reconciliation retain all their time.
unknowns: Current item identity quality and inventory condition categories.
research_questions: Can native fields reduce entry time when costume identities or completeness are uncertain?

already_counted.description: Capture costume inventory and condition details.

incremental.description: Maintain stock views and condition categories.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 case: B=100, R=92, gross=8; upkeep=2 gives net=6. Conservative case: unreliable item identities leave lookup unchanged and entry retains 18 of 20 hours, R=98, net=0. Consistent item metadata with lookup nine and entry 16 gives R=95, net=3. Locating, condition inspection and reconciliation retain 70 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep performer, historical and physical costume judgement human while improving complete sourcing, research and stock records.
reach: Connect production evidence and actual wardrobe condition with dependable costume requirements and sourcing.
role.ambitious_version: A costume attendant who makes careful practical and historical choices with clear, traceable production and inventory records.
